source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: Twice per battle, once this model has been allocated an attack, you may set that attack's Damage characteristic to 0. Two Stealth Drone tokens kept beside the unit can track this; remove one each time the ability is used.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 8 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
